Item.Name: S_EQUIPMENT_TYPE
Item.Hint: Scan Equipment bar code, or enter 'M' for manual entry.

Trigger.Name: KEY-NEXT-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_start_code varchar2(3) := '+';
 temp_end_code varchar2(3) := '+';
 temp_len number;
begin
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 temp_len := length(temp_start_code);
 if :s_equipment_type = 'M' then
 CLEAR_ITEM;
 NEXT_ITEM;
 else
 if length(:s_equipment_type) != 6 + length(temp_start_code) + length(temp_end_code) then
 :s_equipment_type := null;
 show_error ('1210'); --invalid scan length
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 if nvl(substr(:s_equipment_type, 1, temp_len),'nullx') != nvl(temp_start_code,'nullx') or
 nvl(substr(:s_equipment_type, 7 + temp_len, length(temp_start_code)),'nullx') !=
 nvl(temp_end_code,'nullx') then
 :s_equipment_type := null;
 show_error ('6076'); --invalid start/end code
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
-- check and see if a valid equipment reference number
 begin
 select 'x' into :GLOBAL.x from equipment e
 where e.equip_reference = 'EQ-'||substr(:s_equipment_type, temp_len + 1, 6);
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 show_error ('1336');
 check_package_failure;
 end;

-- check and see if authorized to make edits for equipment of this type

 begin
 select 'X' into :global.x
 from fcn_grp_priv f, equip_access_privs ea, equipment e
 where f.appl_id = 'DON'
 and f.user_id = upper(:banner.user_id)
 and ea.fcn_grp = f.grp_id
 and ea.equip_type = e.equip_type
 and e.equip_reference= 'EQ-'||substr(:s_equipment_type, temp_len + 1, 6);
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 show_error ('1302');
 check_package_failure;
 end;
--
-- see if there are any valid QC events defined for equipment of this type
--

 begin
 select 'X' into :GLOBAL.x
 from equip_qc_ctrl_hdr hdr
 where hdr.equip_type in 
 (select e.equip_type from equipment e
 where e.equip_reference= 'EQ-'||substr(:s_equipment_type, temp_len + 1, 6));
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 show_error ('1331');
 check_package_failure;
 when too_many_rows then
 null;
 when others then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;

-- set all ctrl blk values.
 begin
 select e.equip_type, substr(m.code_desc,1,13), e.equip_id, e.equip_reference
 into :CTRL_BLK_1.equipment_type, :CTRL_BLK_1.s_equip_desc, :CTRL_BLK_1.equipment_id,
 :CTRL_BLK_1.equipment_reference
 from equipment e, equip_master_codes m
 where e.equip_reference = 'EQ-'||substr(:s_equipment_type, temp_len + 1, 6)
 and m.code = e.equip_type
 and m.code_type = 'EQUIP';
 exception
 when others then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 GO_ITEM ('EQUIPMENT_REFERENCE');
 execute_trigger ('KEY-NEXT-ITEM');
 end if;
end;

declare
 v_local_time date;
 v_local_date date;
 
begin
 execute_trigger ('validate_field');
 check_package_failure;
 
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,sysdate,v_local_time);
 v_local_date := v_local_time;
 else
 v_local_date := sysdate;
 end if;
--
-- if qc type has already been scheduled, but not done, use it. Otherwise make new.
--
 begin
 select qc.qc_reference into :global.ref_no
 from equip_qc_hdr qc
 where qc.equip_reference = :ctrl_blk_1.equipment_reference
 and qc.qc_type = :qc_hdr.qc_type
 and qc.qc_status = 'S';
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 begin
 select hdr.qc_id, hdr.review_code, substr(mc.code_desc,1,50)
 into :qc_hdr.qc_id, :qc_hdr.qc_status, :qc_hdr.status_desc
 from equip_qc_ctrl_hdr hdr, equip_master_codes mc
 where hdr.equip_type = :ctrl_blk_1.equipment_type
 and hdr.qc_type = :qc_hdr.qc_type
 and v_local_date between hdr.eff_date and nvl(hdr.term_date,v_local_date+1)
 and mc.code_type = 'QCREV'
 and mc.code = hdr.review_code;
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 null;
 when others then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 go_item ('qc_tech_1');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 when others then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 :ctrl_blk_1.qc_ref := :global.ref_no;
 clear_block (no_validate);
 go_block ('qc_hdr');
 execute_query;
 :qc_hdr.program_id := :BANNER.prog_name;
 :qc_hdr.modified_by := :BANNER.user_id;
 :qc_hdr.last_modified_date := v_local_date;
 GO_ITEM ('qc_tech_1');
end;

Trigger.Name: KEY-NEXT-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
-- v_gmt_time date;
v_local_time date; -- jairam aded per IM 5313

begin
 
 execute_trigger ('validate_field');
 check_package_failure;
--
/* -- jairam commentd per IM 5186
 if :qc_hdr.qc_date is not null then
 if IS_TIMEZONE_ENABLED then
 
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_gmt_time(:global.chapter_id,:qc_hdr.qc_date,v_gmt_time);
 :qc_hdr.qc_date := v_gmt_time;
 
 end if; 
 end if;
 */

 if is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,sysdate,v_local_time); 
 else
 v_local_time := sysdate;
 end if; 

 
-- above code by jairam

 if (:qc_det.ref_number is null) then
 begin
 select distinct det.ref_number into :GLOBAL.x
 from equip_qc_ctrl det, equip_qc_ctrl_hdr hdr
 where hdr.equip_type = :ctrl_blk_1.equipment_type
 and hdr.qc_type = :qc_hdr.qc_type
 and hdr.qc_id = det.qc_id
 and v_local_time < nvl (det.term_date, v_local_time+1);
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 go_item ('qc_result_1');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 when too_many_rows then
 null;
 when others then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
--
 if (:qc_hdr.qc_date <= v_local_time) then
 :GLOBAL.result_ind := null;
 message('qc date is less then');
 end if;
--
 if ((:qc_hdr.qc_date <= v_local_time) and (nvl(:GLOBAL.result_ind, 'X') != 'FUTURE')) then
 go_block ('qc_det');
 POP_QC_DET;
 check_package_failure;
 else
 :GLOBAL.result_ind := 'FUTURE';
 go_item ('qc_result_1');
 end if;
 else
 GO_ITEM ('qc_result_1');
 end if;
end;

-- to display another error using show_error. On_error is invoked the first time that the contents 
-- of the date field is referenced, so this section of code just checks for date format errors using the
-- on_error checks.
--
--begin
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,sysdate,v_local_time); 
 else

 if(:qc_hdr.qc_date > v_local_time) then

 if(:qc_hdr.qc_date is null) then

 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,sysdate,v_local_time);
 :qc_hdr.qc_date := v_local_time;
 else

 --end if;

if IS_TIMEZONE_ENABLED then

 if(:qc_hdr.qc_date > v_local_time) then -- jairam added trunc

 else -- timezone

 -- if (nvl(:qc_hdr.qc_result_1,'S')!='S') then
 show_error ('1334');

 -- end if;
 end if;
 end if;
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: POP_QC_DET
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
procedure POP_QC_DET is

 v_local_time date; -- added by jairam per IM 5313
 v_local_date date; 

 cursor qc_det_c1(p_local_date in date) is
 select det.target_value a1,
 det.ref_number a2,
 substr(det.qc_item,1,24) a3,
 substr(det.qc_units,1,8) a4,
 det.min_accept a5,
 det.max_accept a6,
 det.qc_id a7,
 det.arrange_by a8
 from equip_qc_ctrl det, equip_qc_ctrl_hdr hdr
 where hdr.qc_type = :qc_hdr.qc_type
 and hdr.equip_type = :ctrl_blk_1.equipment_type
 and hdr.qc_id = det.qc_id
 and p_local_date between det.eff_date and nvl(det.term_date, p_local_date+1)
 order by det.arrange_by;
 begin
 
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,sysdate,v_local_time);
 v_local_date := v_local_time;
 else
 v_local_date := sysdate;
 end if;
 
 for c1 in qc_det_c1(v_local_date) loop
 begin
 :qc_det.qc_reference := :qc_hdr.qc_reference;
 :qc_det.qc_id := c1.a7;
 :qc_det.ref_number := c1.a2;
 :qc_det.arrange_by := c1.a8;
 :qc_det.repeat_result := null;
 :qc_det.s_qc_description := c1.a3;
 :qc_det.target_value := c1.a1;
 :qc_det.s_qc_descriptor := c1.a4;
 :qc_det.minimum_value := c1.a5;
 :qc_det.maximum_value := c1.a6;
 :qc_det.observed_value := null;
 :qc_det.interpretation := null;
 :qc_det.s_qc_interp := null;
 :qc_det.inserted_by := :banner.user_id;
 :qc_det.insert_date := sysdate;
 next_record;
 end;
 end loop;
 go_record ('1');
end;

PROCEDURE VALIDATE_QC_DET IS
BEGIN
 :GLOBAL.cursor_block := :SYSTEM.cursor_block;

 go_block ('qc_det');

 WHILE (:QC_DET.ref_number is not null) LOOP
 if (:QC_DET.observed_value is null) then

 END LOOP;

ProgramUnit.Name: ASSIGN_QC_STATUS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE assign_qc_status IS
BEGIN
 select decode(qc.review_code, '1', nvl(:qc_hdr.qc_result_1, 'S'),
 decode(:qc_hdr.qc_result_1, 'A', 'I', 'U','I', nvl(:qc_hdr.qc_result_1, 'S')))
 into :qc_hdr.qc_status
 from equip_qc_ctrl_hdr qc
 where qc.equip_type = :ctrl_blk_1.equipment_type
 and qc.qc_type = :qc_hdr.qc_type;
 select substr(mc.code_desc,1,50) into :qc_hdr.status_desc
 from equip_master_codes mc
 where mc.code_type = 'QCSTS'
 and mc.code = :qc_hdr.qc_status;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: VALIDATE_QC_RESULT_1
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE validate_qc_result_1 IS
BEGIN
 if (:qc_det.ref_number is not null) then
 :GLOBAL.cursor_block := :SYSTEM.cursor_block;
 :GLOBAL.cursor_item := :SYSTEM.cursor_item;
 go_block ('qc_det');
 :GLOBAL.cursor_record := :SYSTEM.cursor_record;
 go_record ('1');
 while (:SYSTEM.last_record != 'TRUE') loop
 down;
 end loop;
--
-- search from bottom up for any non "A" statuses, without a subsequent "A" status on the same ref number.
--
-- check last record
--
 if (:qc_det.interpretation = 'U') then
 go_record (:GLOBAL.cursor_record);
 go_block (:GLOBAL.cursor_block);
 go_item ('qc_result_1');
 show_error ('1332');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 :GLOBAL.ref_number := :qc_det.ref_number;
 if (:SYSTEM.cursor_record != '1') then
 up;
 end if;
--
-- check all records other than first and last
--
 while (:SYSTEM.cursor_record != '1') loop
 if ((:qc_det.interpretation = 'U') and (:GLOBAL.ref_number != :qc_det.ref_number)) then
 go_record (:GLOBAL.cursor_record);
 go_block (:GLOBAL.cursor_block);
 go_item ('qc_result_1');
 show_error ('1332');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 :GLOBAL.ref_number := :qc_det.ref_number;
 up;
 end loop;
--
-- at first record. Check for non 'A'
--
 if ((:qc_det.interpretation = 'U') and (:GLOBAL.ref_number != :qc_det.ref_number)) then
 go_record (:GLOBAL.cursor_record);
 go_block (:GLOBAL.cursor_block);
 go_item ('qc_result_1');
 show_error ('1332');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 go_record (:GLOBAL.cursor_record);
 go_block (:GLOBAL.cursor_block);
 go_item (:GLOBAL.cursor_item);
 end if;
END;

Trigger.Name: COMMIT_QC_HDR
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 v_gmt_time date;
 v_local_time date;
 v_local_date date;
 
begin
 execute_trigger ('validate_qc_hdr');
 check_package_failure;
 
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,sysdate,v_local_time);
 v_local_date := v_local_time;
 else
 v_local_date := sysdate;
 end if;


--
-- set all modification data and such
--
 if (:qc_hdr.insert_date is null) then
 :qc_hdr.insert_date := v_local_date;
 end if;
 
 -- jairam commented per IM 5186
 
 if :qc_hdr.qc_date is not null then
 if IS_TIMEZONE_ENABLED then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_gmt_time(:global.chapter_id,:qc_hdr.qc_date,v_gmt_time);
 :qc_hdr.qc_date := v_gmt_time;
 end if; 
 else
 :qc_hdr.qc_date := :qc_hdr.qc_date;
 end if;
 
 ---
 --:qc_hdr.insert_date := sysdate;
 --end if;
--
 if (:SYSTEM.block_status = 'CHANGED') then
 :qc_hdr.last_modified_date := v_local_date;
 :qc_hdr.modified_by := :banner.user_id;
 :qc_hdr.program_id := 'EQIQC1';
 end if;
--
 assign_qc_status;
 check_package_failure;
--
-- Reset machine status to DOWN if QC result is unacceptable, and no subsequent QC of same 
-- type is acceptable
--

 ---
 if :qc_hdr.qc_date is not null then
 --if IS_TIMEZONE_ENABLED then
 --Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_gmt_time(:global.chapter_id,:qc_hdr.qc_date,v_gmt_time);
 :qc_hdr.qc_date := :qc_hdr.qc_date;
 --end if; 
 end if;
 ---
 if (:qc_hdr.qc_result_1= 'U') then
 :GLOBAL.x := null;
 begin
 select 'X' into :GLOBAL.x
 from equip_qc_hdr eqh
 where eqh.equip_reference = :qc_hdr.equip_reference
 and eqh.qc_type = :qc_hdr.qc_type
 and eqh.qc_date > :qc_hdr.qc_date
 and eqh.qc_result_1 = 'A';
 exception when no_data_found then null;
 when too_many_rows then :GLOBAL.x := 'X';
 end;
 if (:GLOBAL.x is null) then
 begin
 update equipment e
 set e.status = 'DOWN'
 where e.equip_reference = :qc_hdr.equip_reference
 and e.status = 'IN'
 and e.chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 /* Modified by HCL Consulting */
 end;
 end if;
 end if;
-- 
-- assign new QC reference if needed. lock table when assigning;
--
 if (:ctrl_blk_1.qc_ref is null) then
 LOCK TABLE equip_qc_hdr in exclusive mode;
 begin
 select 'QC-'||substr(to_char(to_number
 (nvl(max(substr(qc.qc_reference,4)),0))+1,'099999'),2,6)
 into :qc_hdr.qc_reference
 from equip_qc_hdr qc;
 exception
 when others then
 GO_ITEM ('qc_type');
 rollback;
 show_error ('0230');
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 :ctrl_blk_1.qc_ref := :qc_hdr.qc_reference;
 else
 if (:qc_hdr.qc_reference is null) then
 :qc_hdr.qc_reference := :ctrl_blk_1.qc_ref;
 end if;
 end if;
--
 ref_qc_det;
--
 :SYSTEM.message_level := 10;
 commit;
 :SYSTEM.message_level := 0;
 execute_trigger ('KEY-CLRFRM');
 show_error ('0000');
 check_package_failure;
end;
